title: Reliable LLM-Generated Programs for High-Energy Physics Experiments through Graph-Grounded Software Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2609.01095v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Extracting physics information from modern particle-physics experiments requires multistage analyses implemented on top of large and highly interconnected software ecosystems. General-purpose large language models (LLMs) often produce unreliable programs for such tasks because a user request alone rarely specifies the required APIs, dependencies, and usage conventions. We organize these software relations before generation and retrieve task-relevant knowledge at inference time. Using the open-source ROOT framework as a representative and reproducible testbed, we evaluate a complete grounding system that combines hybrid retrieval over a heterogeneous software knowledge graph, skill-selected workflow examples, and execution-guided repair. On a benchmark of 275 ROOT tasks, grounding improves first-attempt execution from 58.5% to 76.0% under Claude Code orchestration and from 51.3% to 64.0% under standalone orchestration. translated_title: 通过基于软件知识图谱的接地技术实现高能物理实验中可靠的大语言模型生成程序
translated_abstract: 从现代粒子物理实验中提取物理信息，需要在庞大且高度互联的软件生态系统之上实现多阶段分析。通用大语言模型（LLM）在此类任务中常常生成不可靠的程序，因为仅凭用户请求很少能明确所需的API、依赖关系和使用惯例。我们在生成之前预先组织这些软件关系，并在推理时检索与任务相关的知识。以开源ROOT框架作为具有代表性且可复现的测试平台，我们评估了一套完整的接地系统，该系统结合了基于异构软件知识图谱的混合检索、经技能筛选的工作流示例，以及执行引导的修复。在一个包含275个ROOT任务的基准测试中，接地技术将Claude Code编排下的首次执行成功率从58.5%提升至76.0%，在独立编排下从51.3%提升至64.0%，最终成功率也有显著提升。
tldr: 该论文构建了异构软件知识图谱并结合混合检索、技能筛选的工作流示例与执行引导修复机制，显著提升了大语言模型在高能物理ROOT软件生态中生成可靠可用程序的成功率。
en_tdlr: This work significantly improves the reliability of LLM-generated programs for the ROOT software ecosystem in high-energy physics by grounding generation in a heterogeneous software knowledge graph combined with hybrid retrieval, skill-selected workflow examples, and execution-guided repair.
